h1: Salin Home Hotel Ramkhamhaeng — 2-Star with 10/10 Cleanliness, Score 8.4, Near ARL Hua Mak from ฿600
intro: In the university-and-community fabric of Ramkhamhaeng–Hua Mak, Salin Home Hotel Ramkhamhaeng stands out for something rarely found at 2-star prices: a cleanliness score of 10 out of 10 from real guests, and an overall rating of 8.4 out of 10 from 364-plus reviews. The 41-room property at 40/1 Soi Ramkhamhaeng 50, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, starts from around ฿600–880 per night. This is a neighbourhood built around students, local residents, and transit commuters rather than tourist sights — and the hotel reflects that honestly. Its strongest practical asset is proximity to ARL Hua Mak station (A4), roughly 1 km away, which connects direct to Suvarnabhumi Airport in about 27 minutes. The MRT Yellow Line at Hua Mak Station opens the route toward Lat Phrao and Samrong. Ramkhamhaeng University is about 2.5 km out; ABAC Hua Mak campus is nearby; Rajamangala National Stadium — Bangkok's principal concert and sports arena — is a few minutes by Grab. The Mall LifeStore Ramkhamhaeng is the neighbourhood's main shopping hub. On-site facilities include a restaurant, free parking, a lift, and 24-hour front desk — more than most properties at this price tier. This review is compiled from genuine guest experiences on Booking.com, Agoda and Trip.com.

body.html: Overview and who it suits — Salin Home Hotel Ramkhamhaeng is a 41-room 2-star budget property at 40/1 Soi Ramkhamhaeng 50, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi — a part of Bangkok defined by student life, local markets, and transit connections rather than tourist sights. What sets it apart from comparable budget properties in the area is a remarkable cleanliness score of 10 out of 10 from real guests, and a service score of 9 out of 10 — figures that reflect genuine operational care at a price point where most guests accept far less. The hotel also offers an on-site restaurant, free parking, and a 24-hour front desk — facilities that go beyond the minimum for a 2-star property. The hotel suits students, families visiting Ramkhamhaeng University or ABAC Hua Mak campus, workers commuting through the area or connecting to Suvarnabhumi Airport, and budget travellers who prioritise cleanliness and transit access over amenities like a pool or gym.

Location and getting around — The hotel's best asset is its position near ARL Hua Mak (A4), approximately 1 km away — reachable in 2–3 minutes by Grab or motorcycle taxi. From ARL Hua Mak, a direct train to Suvarnabhumi Airport takes around 27 minutes, making the hotel a practical choice for early check-ins and late-night arrivals. The MRT Yellow Line at Hua Mak Station sits in the same 1 km radius, connecting the area to Lat Phrao, Asok interchange, and Samrong in the south. Rajamangala National Stadium — Bangkok's main concert and sports venue — is around 1.5 km away (a short Grab). Ramkhamhaeng University is roughly 2.5 km out. The Mall LifeStore Ramkhamhaeng, the neighbourhood's main shopping anchor, is about 2 km. The hotel sits inside a soi rather than on the main road, so reaching most destinations requires Grab or a motorcycle taxi — but that is true of almost all accommodation in this corridor.
"Clean room, good price. Very convenient for ARL Hua Mak — got to the airport quickly with no hassle. Good value for what you pay."

Rooms and facilities — The 41 air-conditioned rooms are divided into four types: Budget Double Room (24 sq m, Queen bed), Standard Double Room (Queen bed), Superior Double Room (slightly larger), and Premier Twin Room (two single beds plus a private balcony — the pick of the range). All rooms come with a 32-inch flat-screen TV, private en-suite bathroom, free Wi-Fi, and complimentary bottled water. Guest reviews consistently single out the freshness of bed linen and the cleanliness of the bathrooms — the 10/10 cleanliness score is not a rounding artefact; it is mentioned repeatedly in individual reviews. The on-site restaurant offers room service, providing a convenient option if you don't want to go out. Free private parking is available for guests who drive — an appreciated extra in this part of Bangkok. The property has a lift. One caveat flagged in reviews: the beds in some rooms are on the firmer side — ask at check-in for extra blankets or padding if that is a concern. No swimming pool or fitness centre.

What real guest reviews say — the praise and the caveats — Across 364-plus reviews on Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com and aggregators, the pattern is consistent. On the positive side: cleanliness earns a perfect 10/10 — reviews specifically mention clean bed linen, fresh bathrooms, and well-maintained rooms; service earns 9/10, with staff described as kind, fast, and genuinely helpful; the location near ARL Hua Mak and access to Suvarnabhumi Airport is cited as a major advantage; value for money receives very strong ratings; the on-site restaurant and free parking are appreciated extras. One memorable guest note: "For the price, it was amazing! They allowed me to check in early which was very helpful." On the watch-out side: beds in some room types are on the firm side — a notable point in multiple reviews; the hotel's position inside a deep soi makes it harder to hail passing taxis; some staff have limited English; rooms tend to be compact, better for a transit stay than a week-long visit. Location ratings are pulled down by the neighbourhood being local-residential rather than tourist-facing.
"Value for money is excellent. Room was small but clean and tidy. Staff were helpful. The noise from outside was noticeable in some rooms — bring earplugs if you're a light sleeper."

Pricing and value — Standard nightly rates start from around ฿600–700 for a Budget or Standard Double Room during off-peak weekdays. The Premier Twin Room with balcony runs to around ฿880. February typically offers the lowest rates of the year — roughly 15% below other months. During concerts or major events at Rajamangala National Stadium, prices across the neighbourhood rise noticeably — book ahead with free cancellation when your dates align with event schedules. For travellers whose primary requirements are a demonstrably clean room, working A/C, a private bathroom, free Wi-Fi, free parking, and fast access to ARL Hua Mak, Salin Home offers the most compelling value proposition in the Ramkhamhaeng area at its price tier. If a pool or gym is on the checklist, neighbouring 3-star options like Witz Bangkok Hotel Ramkhamhaeng or Regent Ramkhamhaeng 22 provide those at a modest premium.

honestSummary: Salin Home Hotel Ramkhamhaeng delivers more than its 2-star billing suggests: a 10/10 cleanliness score and 9/10 service rating from 364-plus real guest reviews, free parking, an on-site restaurant, and a lift — at prices from ฿600. The hotel knows its audience and executes its proposition well. Honest trade-offs: firm beds in some room types (addressable at check-in), deep-soi taxi access, and compact rooms better suited to transit stays than extended visits.
honestChecks: If you find firm beds uncomfortable — mattress firmness appears in multiple reviews across room types. Ask at check-in for extra blankets or padding, or consider booking the Premier Twin Room (which includes a balcony and generally receives better comfort reviews) rather than the Budget Double.

If you need a pool, gym, or dedicated leisure facilities — Salin Home is a clean, practical property, not a leisure hotel. Witz Bangkok Hotel Ramkhamhaeng has two outdoor pools and a gym; Regent Ramkhamhaeng 22 is a solid 3-star alternative — both available at a modest price step up from Salin Home.

If you rely on taxis rather than Grab — the deep-soi location makes flagging passing taxis difficult, and a ฿50 surcharge applies for phoning a taxi from this area. Use the Grab app instead — it removes this friction entirely and is the most cost-effective option for the airport run too.

tips.title: ARL Hua Mak — Airport in 27 Minutes
tips.body: Grab to ARL Hua Mak (A4) takes 2–3 minutes. A direct ARL train to Suvarnabhumi takes 27 minutes. This beats a taxi both on cost and reliability — especially valuable for early morning flights.

tips.title: Ask About Bed Comfort at Check-In
tips.body: Beds in some room types run firm. Ask at check-in for extra blankets, a mattress pad, or consider upgrading to the Premier Twin Room (balcony) — generally the most comfortable room category here.

tips.title: Student-Area Street Food on the Doorstep
tips.body: Soi Ramkhamhaeng 50 is a student neighbourhood — noodle shops, rice stalls, and convenience stores are all within walking distance. A full meal for under ฿80 is easy to find at almost any time of day.

tips.title: February = Best Rates of the Year
tips.body: Data from booking platforms shows February rates run roughly 15% lower than the rest of the year. If your dates are flexible, February offers the best Salin Home value. Rajamangala event dates push prices up — book early with free cancellation when in doubt.

faq.q: Where is Salin Home Hotel Ramkhamhaeng and what is nearby?
faq.a: The hotel is at 40/1 Soi Ramkhamhaeng 50, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240. Nearby: ARL Hua Mak (A4) ~1 km — connects to Suvarnabhumi Airport in 27 min; MRT Yellow Line Hua Mak Station ~1 km; Rajamangala National Stadium ~1.5 km; Ramkhamhaeng University ~2.5 km; The Mall LifeStore Ramkhamhaeng ~2 km. Phone: +66 2 732 2286.

faq.q: What is the review score and starting price at Salin Home Hotel Ramkhamhaeng?
faq.a: The hotel scores 8.4 out of 10 from 364-plus real guest reviews, with a cleanliness score of 10/10 — exceptional for a 2-star property. Rates start from around ฿600 per night for a Budget Double Room (24 sq m). February tends to be the cheapest month — roughly 15% below the annual average.

faq.q: Who is Salin Home Hotel Ramkhamhaeng best suited for?
faq.a: Best suited for budget-conscious travellers who prioritise cleanliness, students, families visiting Ramkhamhaeng University or ABAC Hua Mak, workers transiting through Bangkok's east side, and anyone connecting to Suvarnabhumi Airport via ARL Hua Mak.

faq.q: How do I get from Suvarnabhumi Airport to Salin Home Hotel?
faq.a: Take the Airport Rail Link (ARL) from the airport to ARL Hua Mak Station (A4) — around 27 minutes. From Hua Mak station, use Grab (2–3 minutes) to the hotel. This is faster and cheaper than a taxi, which also carries a ฿50 phone-booking surcharge in this area.

faq.q: Does Salin Home Hotel have free parking and a restaurant?
faq.a: Yes to both. Free private parking is available for in-house guests (confirm in advance). The hotel has an on-site restaurant with room service — a genuine added value compared with most properties at this price point.

faq.q: What room type should I book at Salin Home Hotel Ramkhamhaeng?
faq.a: The Premier Twin Room (two single beds, private balcony) is generally the best option if available — it tends to receive the most positive reviews for comfort and space. The Budget Double (24 sq m, Queen bed) is the most affordable entry point and is perfectly adequate for a 1–2 night stay.
